messages:
sam_support: customer AcmePayments reporting sudden 403s from EU edge after an API key rotation this morning. They rotated key via Console -> Keys and now some of their webhooks are failing intermittently.

alice_oncall: thanks Sam — can you paste the request ID and example header they sent?

sam_support: request-id: req_eu_0a1b2c3d4e, header: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_****** (customer redacted). They see 403 body: '{\"error\":\"api_key_revoked\"}' for ~20% of requests, other 80% succeed. Happens only hitting eu-west-1 endpoints.

alice_oncall: hmm sounds like a cached credential somewhere. Are they using any proxies / edge caches / CDN?

sam_support: yes - they front with our edge proxy and also run a small fleet of webhooks on ECS with Vault sidecar that pulls env vars.

carlos_infra: adding context: we've seen similar pattern when sidecar env var reloads lag after Vault rotation. If some pods keep old env and keep long-lived connections, edge may accept some while rejecting others depending on header routing.

sam_support: customer says they rolled keys at 07:12 UTC, errors started ~07:20 UTC and persisted sporadically until ~08:30 UTC.

alice_oncall: can we confirm Vault K/V v2 propagation? @carlos_infra any propagation logs?

carlos_infra: checking Vault audit and agent logs now. early finding: the Vault KV update committed at 07:12 but the sidecar lease renews were at 07:40 for a subset of pods — looks like agent lease TTL was long (default 30m) so many pods didn't fetch the new value until lease expiry. Also spotted a Helm chart that lacks the checksum annotation on the secret volume, so kube didn't trigger pod restart on secret change.

sam_support: so some pods still had old key in env -> sending old key -> 403. That maps to customer observed success/failure split. Good catch.

alice_oncall: what's the fix path we can advise customer now? Need quick remediation: propose a forced rollout of the webhook deployment to restart pods and pick up new secret, or a manual sidecar agent reload.

dana_runtime: confirm both options. Quick remediation options: 1) kubectl rollout restart deployment/webhooks (forces pods to restart and read updated env) 2) run vault-agent with `vault agent -config=/etc/vault/agent.hcl -once` inside affected pods to fetch new secret (if they have exec access) 3) issue a temporary scoped API key from Console for their webhook while they fix rollout.

sam_support: customer wants least disruptive — they prefer a targeted rollout. I'll propose `kubectl rollout restart` for the webhook deployment in eu-west only.

carlos_infra: long term: we should recommend adding the secret checksum annotation in their Helm chart, example: `checksum/secret: {{ include (print $.Release.Name \"-secret\") . | sha256sum }}` so k8s restarts pods on secret change. Also we should review our Vault Agent default lease TTL docs.

dana_runtime: actionable infra ticket: enforce recommended Helm pattern in our quickstart templates and add a note in docs about agent TTLs and forcesync commands. I'll open an eng-runtime ticket and tag eng-infra. PR planned: GH#5462 to add checksum to the example chart and GH#5473 to document forced agent sync.

vault-bot: Vault audit: update kv/data/webhooks/acmepayments at 2026-03-16T07:12:08Z by admin@acme — version 9 -> new_secret_id: secret_... (redacted).

deploy-bot: ci:helm-lint passed for chart-acme-webhooks (branch: fix/secret-checksum) — pipeline 7821.

alice_oncall: Sam — please relay rollback options to customer and recommended immediate step: roll restart of webhooks in eu-west and confirm errors drop to 0. Offer temporary API key if they need zero downtime. Marking this thread escalated to eng-runtime for the Helm template updates.

sam_support: will do. I pinged customer with targeted rollout and temporary scoped key offer. They applied rollout at 07:55 UTC and reported errors dropped to 0 by 08:01 UTC. Customer happy for now and will follow up to update Helm chart.

carlos_infra: follow-ups for us: 1) update docs + quickstart 2) add a short blurb in rotation KB about sidecar TTL and pod restart requirement 3) consider adding a console option to optionally touch deployments when rotating keys (opt-in) to avoid this class of outage.

dana_runtime: filing GH issues and linking to this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam_support: closing on support side — will re-open if customer sees regressions.

alice_oncall: great triage, team. Logged internal incident note and linked customer case #CS-90421.

sam_support: (closing note) commands we suggested to customer:
```
# targeted rollout in eu-west
kubectl --context=eu-west rollout restart deployment/acme-webhooks -n payments

# one-off vault agent fetch (if needed)
kubectl exec -n payments $POD -- vault agent -config=/etc/vault/agent.hcl -once
```
Thanks everyone.
